text: Antonio Damasio's ___ hypothesis (Descartes' Error, 1994) holds that fast emotional signals from the body guide decision-making, so that patients with ventromedial prefrontal damage reason poorly in real life despite intact intelligence.
explanation: Damasio's somatic-marker hypothesis makes emotion constitutive of good practical reasoning rather than opposed to it -- the opposite of Descartes' picture of pure disembodied reason. It is a modern descendant of the James-Lange emphasis on bodily feedback, extended to decision-making via the ventromedial prefrontal cortex.
